instructions.name: creator_withdraw
docs: After expiry the creator takes back everything left in the treasury.
Blocked while claims are pending, unless the oracle has been silent for
FORCE_WITHDRAW_DELAY past expiry.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: One-time protocol setup. Only the program's upgrade authority can call this,
so nobody can front-run deployment and install their own oracle.

instructions.name: pay_premium
docs: Renew a weather policy for another month.

instructions.name: raise_claim
docs: File a claim against the policy's own insured risk. The oracle picks it up
from the `ClaimFiled` event (or by polling) and settles it.

instructions.name: release_lapsed_policy
docs: Frees the capital backing a weather policy that can no longer be renewed or
claimed on (its owner stopped paying). Permissionless: the conditions alone
guarantee no legitimate claim is cut off, and underwriters get their
capacity back without waiting for the vault to expire.

instructions.name: set_vault_paused
docs: Pausing only stops new subscriptions. Existing policyholders can always
renew and get their claims settled, so a creator can't pause their way out of a payout.

instructions.name: settle_claim
docs: Only the configured oracle can settle. The verdict, the measured value and a
hash of the evidence are recorded on-chain so anyone can audit the decision.

accounts.name: claimant_usdc
docs: Created if the claimant closed their USDC account, so a payout can't be blocked.

instructions.name: subscribe
docs: Buy a policy: registers the insured risk and pays the first premium atomically,
so capacity can't be squatted by free subscriptions.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Rotate the oracle key and/or hand over admin rights.

instructions.name: withdraw_excess_liquidity
docs: Withdraw capital that isn't backing any policy. Exposure stays fully collateralised.

fields.name: status
docs: Kept before the variable-length `risk` so it sits at a fixed offset
(CLAIM_STATUS_OFFSET) and indexers can filter pending claims with memcmp.

fields.name: risk
docs: Snapshot of the policy's insured risk at filing time.

fields.name: observed_value
docs: Measured value the oracle decided on: rainfall in 0.1 mm, or delay in minutes
(-1 = cancelled). 0 while pending.

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: sha256 of the oracle's evidence bundle (raw API data + reasoning), served by the keeper.

types.name: Config
docs: Protocol-wide settings. Created once by the program's upgrade authority.

fields.name: oracle_authority
docs: The only key allowed to settle claims.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: The only mint vaults may be denominated in (USDC).

types.name: InsuredRisk
docs: The thing a policy insures. Fixed at subscription time so a claimant
can't pick whichever location or flight happened to have a bad day.

fields.name: latitude_e6
docs: Degrees × 1e6

fields.name: longitude_e6
docs: Degrees × 1e6

fields.name: flight_number
docs: IATA flight number, e.g. "AI101"

fields.name: flight_date
docs: UTC midnight of the scheduled departure date

fields.name: covered_from
docs: When coverage began (first premium or coverage_start, whichever is later).

fields.name: released
docs: Set by `release_lapsed_policy` once every renewal and claim window has
closed; its payout no longer counts against the vault's capacity.

types.name: Region
docs: Weather vaults only insure farms inside this box, so a policy priced for one
climate can't be bought for a much drier one. Micro-degrees; all zero for flight vaults.

fields.name: observation_days
docs: Weather only: length of the trailing rainfall window, in days.

fields.name: region
docs: Weather only: where insured farms may be.

fields.name: total_liquidity
docs: Creator capital backing the policies (deposits − payouts − excess withdrawals).

fields.name: creator_fees_accrued
docs: Creator fees sitting in the treasury that the creator hasn't collected yet.

fields.name: active_policies
docs: Policies that can still be paid out. `active_policies * coverage_amount`
is the vault's outstanding exposure and must stay <= `total_liquidity`.

fields.name: is_paused
docs: Blocks new subscriptions only; never blocks renewals or claim settlement.

fields.name: is_closed
docs: Set once the creator has withdrawn after expiry.

constants.name: CLAIM_FILING_GRACE
docs: Weather claims can be filed up to this long after paid coverage ends; the
rainfall window always ends at the coverage end, so no uncovered day counts.

constants.name: CLAIM_STATUS_OFFSET
docs: Byte offset of `Claim.status` (discriminator 8 + vault 32 + claimant 32 +
policy 32 + claim_number 8). Off-chain sweeps filter on it.

constants.name: FORCE_WITHDRAW_DELAY
docs: If claims are still pending this long after `vault_expiry` (oracle offline),
the creator may withdraw anyway so funds are never locked forever.

constants.name: GRACE_PERIOD
docs: How long after `personal_coverage_end` a policy can still be renewed.

constants.name: MAX_CREATOR_FEE_BPS
docs: Creators can take at most 50% of each premium.

constants.name: MAX_OBSERVATION_DAYS
docs: Weather vaults measure rainfall over a trailing window of this many days (max).

constants.name: MONTH
docs: Length of one premium period.

constants.name: ORACLE_FEE
docs: Anti-spam fee charged when a claim is filed (0.005 USDC). Goes to the treasury.
